title: GeoPackage attribute named group breaks ordinary OGR SQL consumption without quoting
workflow: generated GeoJSON -> GeoPackage -> OGR SQL grouped inspection
symptom: The first real grouped SQL query failed near the field name group even though GeoPackage creation and layer inspection succeeded.
expected_behavior: A normal unquoted attribute name should be convenient to query through the target GeoPackage/SQLite consumer.
actual_behavior: SELECT group, COUNT(*) ... failed because group is a SQL keyword in the consumer surface.
proposed_fix: Expose the GeoPackage property as cluster rather than the internal generator key group.
fix_attempt: Changed generated GeoJSON properties from group to cluster, rebuilt the GeoPackage from scratch, and repeated the original grouped SQL query without quoting.
verification: OGR SQL returned all five clusters and counts successfully; final GeoPackage contains the cluster field and no group field.
